'''Noeu sphere racquets'''<ref name="Inside" /> were a type of [[Color/Legends|silver]]-colored device consisting of a handle attached to a large body. The [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] kept a noeu sphere racquet in [[Gender/Legends|his]] bedroom in his home in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which includes the appearance of the noeu sphere racquet, to [[32 BBY]].</ref> the racquet was lent against the wall by his bed when he showed [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who he had been building.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
A noeau sphere racquet first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The racquet was first named in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
